aboutText: I'm an IT student passionate about cybersecurity, with a focus on binary and web exploitation. I also work with Linux systems, server infrastructure, and web development, learning through hands-on projects, CTF competitions, and experimentation.
philosophyText: “somewhere i have never travelled, gladly beyond.”

journey.desc: I started my journey with a strong curiosity about computers and how digital systems work. This curiosity led me to explore programming and technology more deeply.

I found cybersecurity through Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges. I started with digital forensics, then moved into binary exploitation (pwn), which is now most of my writeups, and I'm expanding into web exploitation.
I run Linux (CachyOS) as my daily driver and self-host my own services on a homelab: Docker and Coolify behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, with a DevSecOps dashboard monitoring the servers and containers.
I build full-stack web apps with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL, from a class hub and a school e-voting system to this portfolio, and deploy them on my own infrastructure.

My goal is to grow as a cybersecurity professional specializing in binary and web exploitation, with Linux administration and web development as my foundation, while I keep learning, building, and competing in CTFs.
